cohort: 128 fixed Sili validation sequences; CPP matched subset; same frozen pilot arrays
reference: CPP satellite retrieval reference; not independent physical truth

selection_rule.growth: >=10 valid leads; CPP peak>=30; peak at >=75 min; later peak exceeds first-four mean by >=15 COT
selection_rule.decay: >=10 valid leads; first-five peak>=30; first-five peak exceeds last-four mean by >=15 COT
selection_rule.motion_proxy: >=10 valid leads; peak>=15; trajectory range>=15; precomputed history motion norm>=1 pixel/15min; a motion proxy, not verified cloud-object tracking
selection_rule.low_cot_control: >=12 valid leads; peak<20; trajectory range<10 COT
selection_rule.sampling: up to two distinct BJT dates per category, evenly spaced across eligible dates; no duplicate sequence across categories; selection does not inspect GHI or forecast error
